notes.title: 4.1 Update “Ukrainian Shield: IRAQ” - 23.05.2025 🚀
notes.notes:
[b] After a long wait and intensive work, we have finally released a new update. It is smaller in scope than previously promised, but includes all the key fixes and additions you’ve been waiting for. [/b]

[b]### 🔹 What’s New and Changes
[/b]

New map “For testing the new unit – BTR‑80”
[list]
[*] * Test version, not yet optimized for RTX.
[/list]

New unit – BTR‑80 with cannon
[list]
[] Realistic model.
[/list]

Translation fixes
[list]
[] Removed localization inaccuracies.
[/list]

Optimization improvements

[list]
[] * Real‑time texture streaming.
[] * Pre‑baking of key elements.
[] * Updated rendering and animation processing.
[] * Faster virtual texture loading.
[/list]

Startup splash + age restriction warning

Steam achievements (testing mode)

Stabilized Steam connection

Updated vegetation rendering on all maps

[b]### ⚠️ Potential Issues and Solutions
[/b]

Green‑yellow‑blue artifacts
May appear instead of UI textures or the “mini‑map.”

Restart your PC or the game.

Switch to SSR lighting.

Upgrade your video chip if necessary.

Duplicate objects in the main menu
Related to CPU multithreading.

Restart the game when it first occurs.

If it happens again, let us know in the comments.

Low FPS

Weak CPU + powerful GPU: enable RTX or SSR. Lumen is not recommended.

Weak GPU + strong CPU: set Intel XeSS to “Performance” mode. Disable V‑sync.

You can reduce the draw distance.

Missing map
Legacy bug from incorrect draw‑distance calculations.

Increase draw distance by one notch in settings.

Thank you for your support and patience. Enjoy the game — we’re glad you’re with us! 😊

[i]"P.S. We are currently working on a new multiplayer game. Thank you for understanding the delays in this update."[/i]

notes.title: Ukrainian Shield: Iraq – Update Delay & Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone following us on Steam! We’re sorry, but we must postpone our upcoming update. It will include:

one new map,

interface improvements,

additional AI optimization,

the BTR-80 armored vehicle (and possibly cargo trucks).

We will release the update as soon as we have enough time to finish and optimize it to an acceptable level.

At the same time, we must say: there will be no story mode. 😞 After careful consideration, we did not receive enough Steam community support, nor did the project break even.

But we won’t stop. We work daily on a brand-new game centered on multiplayer. We guarantee full functionality and question the relevance of single-player experiences.

Our next project is not just a new challenge—it will deliver far more gameplay content that was sadly missing from Ukrainian Shield: Iraq at launch. Why? USI was our internal “Battle Labs,” where we experimented with:

hardware ray tracing,

software ray tracing,

semi-static SSR reflections,

Intel XeSS frame generation,

Unreal Engine virtual texturing,

combining Unreal Nanite and LOD to reduce CPU load.

These technologies ran at a high level. It’s a pity they went unnoticed—players care about gameplay, not just rendering.

We’re not closing the book on Ukrainian Shield: Iraq. We’re simply reallocating 80–90 % of our resources to a new project, which we’ll reveal later.

Thank you for your support. 🙏 Please help us spread the word about our next game—it means as much to us as our first. ❤️

notes.title: Important Update on "Ukrainian Shield: Iraq" - Major Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, defenders of the Ukrainian shield![/h1]
We have important news for you: at this time, there will be no new updates for [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437180/Ukrainian_Shield_Iraq/]"Ukrainian Shield: Iraq"[/url][/b]. We are currently working on a major update that will bring the game closer to its final release. This update will include many significant changes, improvements, and new elements that will make the game even more engaging and realistic.

[b]We plan to release the new update by April 28[/b]. However, it's important to note that while we are actively working on adding new features, we cannot guarantee that the update will include transportation or significant new content.
[h2]In the future[/h2]
Players can look forward to new missions that will add more variety and challenges to the game. This is just one of the steps preparing the game for its final release.

Your support is incredibly important to us. We greatly need your help in spreading the word about the game so that more people can learn about [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437180/Ukrainian_Shield_Iraq/]"Ukrainian Shield: Iraq"[/url][/b]. Your involvement will help us make the game even better and allow us to cover development costs. So, if you support us, please remember to share your impressions, feedback, and help spread the game among friends and acquaintances.

Thank you for your support and dedication! Without you, this journey would not be possible. Stay with us; there's much more exciting content ahead!
